device: RTX 4070 Laptop, NOT a Pi, NOT a datacenter GPU
method: taskset -c 7 ffmpeg CPU hevc decode 1080p30, scale=160:90,format=gray, 15 s video
note: single-core HEVC 1080p baseline; NVDEC comparison lands with factory sweep (queued). Machine CPUs saturated during run - reskach if contested.
regenerate: taskset -c 7 ffmpeg -hide_banner -v error -nostdin -ss 60 -t 15 -i <clip> -vf scale=160:90,format=gray -f rawvideo -pix_fmt gray pipe:1 | wc -c
